title: Study about the impact of open source software and hardware on technological independence, competitiveness and innovation in the EU economy
authors: Blind, K. et al. (Fraunhofer ISI with OpenForum Europe)
organisation: Fraunhofer ISI / OpenForum Europe / European Commission DG CNECT
summary: Commission-commissioned study estimating the economic contribution of open source software to EU GDP and proposing an open source industrial policy.
key_findings: fact: Estimates OSS contributes EUR 65-95 billion to EU GDP.
fact: A 10% increase in OSS contributions is estimated to add about 0.4-0.6% to EU GDP.
fact: Recommends a dedicated open source industrial policy and a network of Open Source Programme Offices.

title: Impact of open source (project page)

title: Study on the impact of open source software and hardware (full report PDF, hosted by Italian government)

title: The Value of Open Source Software
authors: Hoffmann, M.; Nagle, F.; Zhou, Y.
summary: HBS working paper valuing OSS from usage (demand side) rather than recreation cost.
key_findings: fact: Supply-side value about USD 4.15 billion; demand-side value up to USD 8.8 trillion (secondary reporting).
fact: Firms would spend about 3.5 times more on software without OSS.
fact: A small share (5%) of developers create 96% of demand-side value.

title: Open Source Software and Firm Productivity

title: Digital Dark Matter and the Economic Contribution of Apache

title: The impact of open source software on GDP (cross-country panel 2000-2018)
summary: Panel study of OSS and national GDP; title as seen in listing not confirmed.

title: The Relationship Between Open Source Software and Standard Setting
